title: Require the gitleaks job as a status check on the main branch ruleset
description: In GitHub settings for OnFinance/mongodb-mcp-server, add secrets-gitleaks (from code-health.yml, added in task 3) as a required status check in the ruleset or branch protection for main, and for release/* per policy.json branching.protectedBranches. Disallow bypass except for repository admins in a documented emergency. This makes the policy's blocking: true real: today repos/mongodb-mcp-server.json has no branchProtection block and the probe could not confirm a required check. Export the resulting ruleset (gh api repos/OnFinance/mongodb-mcp-server/rulesets or /branches/main/protection) as evidence. Apply outside an active release cut, so open release PRs are not blocked mid-merge.
acceptanceCriteria: gh api repos/OnFinance/mongodb-mcp-server/rules/branches/main lists a required_status_checks rule that includes the secrets-gitleaks context
A test PR whose secrets-gitleaks job fails shows 'Merging is blocked' and cannot be merged by a non-admin
The same required check is present for release/* branches

verificationMethod.description: Review the exported ruleset JSON from gh api repos/OnFinance/mongodb-mcp-server/rules/branches/main and a screenshot or API record of the blocked test PR. Expected: secrets-gitleaks is a required status check on main and release/*, and the failing test PR was not mergeable.

rootCause.description: The policy declares the secrets gate as blocking, but nothing enforces it on protected branches, so even a correctly configured scanner would be advisory.
